entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Parts and accessories of the motor vehicles of headings 8701 to 8705
entries.comment: This rate applies only to parts and accessories for the adaptation of cars and other motor vehicles for the disabled: engine handling adjustments; adj. for handling the handbrake; adj. for handling the steering mechanism; specially designed car seats and cushions; adaptation for use of secondary functions, including adj. mirrors, central lockings, windscreen wipers, indicators and lights; car lifts for lifting a person into a car; wheelchair lifting equipment and securing devices.
